text:
sasha: Intake for 'Cobalt' customer. They want an instruct-tuned variant of terran-13B with 64k context and INT4 quantization. High priority (SLA: 99.9% uptime, p95 latency < 400ms for 512-token responses). Need bring-up checklist + quant sweep plan. Who can own?

lee: Assigned to eng-ml triage. Quick Qs: is their traffic mostly chat (multi-turn) or single-prompt completions?

sasha: multi-turn assistant + API bulk reranking jobs. Expect mixed load: spikes during business hours, otherwise low constant RPS. Data residency: EMEA only (VPC). Customer asks for private deployment.

maya: Important: private deployment changes rollout. We'll need a private control-plane package + dedicated capacity. Also KMS integration for keys.

trent: For quantization: INT4 on 13B is feasible but expect quality delta on instruction-following. We should run an initial quant-sweep: FP16 baseline, PTQ-INT8, QAT-INT4 (or QLoRA+QAT), plus a 4-bit GPTQ run. Prioritize FP16 vs INT4 divergence on our eval suites.

natalie: Suggested eval suites: instruction-following set (2000 examples), long-context coherency bench (64k passages + QA), safety/regression test set, and a customer-provided 1500-case prompt set. We'll also add unit tests for tool-calling/fn outputs.

lee: Can bench-bot run a quick perf/quality matrix? Bench-bot: starting background job.

bench-bot: running: terran-13B (fp16, ptq8, gptq4, qat4) on p4d with 64k context tokens simulated. Will post summary in ~30m.

maya: Operation notes: we need a variant naming scheme: cobalt-terran-13b-instruct-64k-int4. Also store model pin and semantic SHA. Policy: if INT4 causes >2% automated eval drop vs FP16 on instruction set, auto-fail and fallback to INT8.

trent: Also add a metric for hallucination rate and answer consistency across chunks. For long-context, check KV cache correctness and attention window handling.

sasha: Prioritization: this is a paid enterprise with reserved capacity. Priority: P1 bring-up. ETA: want staged canary in 2 weeks.

lee: Roadmap items: (1) infra enable (VPC + dedicated pool) (2) quant experiments (3) evals + perf (4) canary plan + rollback. I'll create an RFC doc tomorrow.

natalie: Eval thresholds: instruction EM >= 92% of FP16 baseline, safety false-positive delta <0.5%, p95 latency < 400ms with batching up to 4.

trent: If INT4 fails, we can try mixed-precision kernel (KV cache in FP16, matmul in 4-bit) or fallback quant schedule (per-layer quant zones).

sasha: Customer wants A/B for 2 weeks. Need telemetry: token-level cost, latency, per-route accuracy metrics, and regression alerts.

lee: @deploy-bot will coordinate canary once we have a model artifact passing bench.

deploy-bot: noted. Canary policy: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 60% -> 100% with 1h observation windows and auto-rollback on error rate >1% or metric regression threshold.

bench-bot: quick results (summary):
- FP16 baseline: p95 latency 350ms, tokens/sec 42, instruction EM 100 (baseline)
- PTQ-INT8: p95 340ms, tokens/sec 45, instruction EM 99.4
- GPTQ-INT4: p95 330ms, tokens/sec 58, instruction EM 95.6
- QAT-INT4: p95 335ms, tokens/sec 55, instruction EM 97.8

trent: Good. GPTQ alone drops too much on instructions; QAT looks promising. We should attempt layerwise GPTQ tuning targeting critical layers.

natalie: Long-context coherency: QAT-INT4 dropped on chunk-boundary QA by ~3 points vs FP16. Need targeted finetune on long-context windows.

maya: Ops ask: for private deployment, we need signed image and offline model bundle. ETA for build artifacts: 5 working days after quant config finalized.

lee: Action items:
- trent: run refined QAT with long-context finetune & layerwise GPTQ attempts (owner)
- bench-bot: run expanded safety + hallucination bench (owner)
- maya: prepare private deployment package + KMS integration checklist
- natalie: assemble eval dashboard and baseline metrics + alert thresholds
- sasha: coordinate with customer on A/B timing and provide sample prompts

sasha: I'll sync with customer today and share their 1500-case set.

trent: I'll start the QAT runs tonight. Will post intermediate checkpoints here.

bench-bot: queued the safety suite and hallucination tests; estimated finish 12h.

deploy-bot: FYI: once we hit canary readiness, I need a release artifact name and target pool in the private region (eu-west-1). Keep me posted.

lee: Thanks everyone. I'll create the RFC + checklist doc and link once done. Short sync tomorrow 10am PT.

sasha: :thumbsup:
